name: Zing-0.5
model_version: Zing-0.5 generator/model.pt (5B causal world model, 4-step DMD, no CFG) on Wan2.2-TI2V-5B; code seedleap/zing-world-model@11212da06f63

weights.repo: seedleap/zing-0.5@b9ca1ed1 (generator/model.pt, pretrained/text_encoder UMT5-XXL, pretrained/vae Wan2.2 VAE)

notes: Text or image start (t2v and i2v tracks). 832x480 at 24 fps (the paper's real-time setting), causal blocks of 4 latent frames (16 frames) after a separate first latent, generated live with upstream's per-chunk loop (4 DMD steps, clean-context pass). Online prompt change uses the model's own mechanism (text_prompt_interval semantics: text K/V cache replaced at the next block, visual K/V cache kept, the first block of the new prompt pinned); the block prompt is '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>'. No keyboard input is invented: camera_control text is given as prompt text and the action input is absent (as in upstream's text-only rollouts). Cache: upstream README's online window (33 latents incl. a 5-latent sink) with Seedleap's realtime-server RoPE (block_relative, gap 12) so sessions are not limited by the 1024-position table. Image start: the image is center-cropped to 832:480 and encoded as latent 0 (upstream TI2V). Mid-session reference images have no model input (reference_update unsupported).
